**What integration or feature are you proposing?**
(e.g. "Meta Pixel", "LinkedIn Insight Tag", "per-page opt-out of a tracker")

**Why can't this be done with the existing custom snippet fields?**
Custom head/body snippets already cover a lot of ad-hoc cases — a first-class field is worth adding when the integration is common enough that many sites would want it, or needs validation/logic the generic snippet fields don't give you.

**Proposed settings fields**
(name, type, description — see `admin.settingsSchema` in `index.mjs` for the existing pattern)
